course_name_original: UE Mathématiques pour les sciences de l'ingénieur - MAT405 -
syllabus_topics: Image and kernel of a matrix; rank theorem; solutions of a system (general and particular cases - square, compatible, homogeneous)

Eigen elements; characteristic polynomial; eigenspace; multiplicity orders of an eigenvalue; diagonalization (conditions: general case and real symmetric matrix); orthogonal matrix; singular value decomposition (SVD)
TP applications of SVD: matrix conditioning; image compression
Differential equations (ODE) and systems of ODE
Classification (order, linearity); first-order ODE system; link between ODE and system; Cauchy problem; equilibrium states; phase plane and vector field
institution: Institut National Polytechnique De Grenoble — Licence Électronique-Énergie électrique-Automatique (UGA)
degree: Licence Électronique, énergie électrique, automatique, parcours EEA (2e et 3e année)
